harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Persistently disabled IPv4 ICMP redirect acceptance and source-routed packet acceptance on node1 via /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf (accept_redirects, secure_redirects, accept_source_route for both all/default set to 0), applied at runtime with sysctl --system, then restarted node1 and confirmed via a changed boot_id and re-verified sysctl values that the hardening persisted across reboot.
actions_performed: Captured pre-change boot_id baseline and existing sysctl values on node1 (cmd-2ea776401d2c485a)

Wrote /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf setting net.ipv4.conf.{all,default}.accept_redirects=0, secure_redirects=0, accept_source_route=0 and applied with sysctl --system, verifying runtime values (cmd-7ba2173d48df4f07)
Captured pre-restart boot_id and scheduled a background reboot so the ack returned before disconnection (cmd-de444367f7a44669)

Polled node1 across the reboot: unchanged boot_id before restart (cmd-d4786d0565fc4449), connection timeout during restart (cmd-6918e3268069456c), then new boot_id confirming restart completed (cmd-a829807394df40f9)
Verified post-restart: new boot_id, persistent config file content, and runtime sysctl values all show the hardening settings intact (cmd-cfc649ddb3c94907)

evidence.requirement: Healthy baseline before change (pre-existing sysctl state and boot identity)
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 1e0cb179-d384-41f8-aa25-9390b31eec45 and pre-change sysctl values (accept_redirects=1, accept_source_route default=1) before any modification

evidence.requirement: Persistently disable ICMP redirect acceptance and source-routed packet acceptance for IPv4
evidence.summary: Created /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf with accept_redirects=0, secure_redirects=0, accept_source_route=0 for all/default, applied via sysctl --system, and confirmed runtime values are 0

evidence.requirement: Node restart acknowledgement returned before disconnection
evidence.summary: Reboot scheduled in background (ack returned), and boot_id still matched pre-restart value on the immediate next poll, proving the command didn't hang and reboot was deferred as intended

evidence.requirement: Direct proof node actually restarted (changed boot identity, not just elapsed time)

After restart, /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf still present and runtime sysctl values for accept_redirects, secure_redirects, and accept_source_route (all/default) confirmed as 0, proving persistence across reboot
